title: dashboard pie/donut/funnel/treemap chart with two dimensions draws only the first second-dimension group, silently
body:
domain:ui#1 · os-sales · session_01L6bhgXU26UBEjd1KKHgNEx

Filing gate: ① a user-visible product defect, found beside #27460 (PR #27560) by the dev's read of the chart renderer at head `13e084eb`. reach: NOT MEASURED by render (a bare jsdom render probe was non-deterministic for pie and drew no marks for funnel/treemap); the code read is below.
Business reason: a dashboard pie, donut, funnel or treemap widget with two dimensions and one measure looks complete but shows only the first group of the second dimension; every other group is dropped and nothing on the chart says so. This is the same class #27460 fixed for sankey.
Reader who acts: the triage seat (first grading), then the implementer for the chart renderer (`ui/packages/plugin-charts/src/AdvancedChartImpl.tsx`).
Dedupe words: pie two dimensions, pivot series[0], funnel second dimension, treemap pivot dropped.

## Symptom

With `dimensions: [a, b]` and one measure, `buildChartSeries` pivots `b` into one series per value. The pie/donut, funnel and treemap arms read `series[0]?.dataKey` only, so only the first `b` value is drawn.

## Mechanism

- `ui/packages/plugin-charts/src/AdvancedChartImpl.tsx`: the pie/donut, funnel and treemap arms bind `series[0]` and read no other series.
- `ui/packages/plugin-dashboard/src/DatasetWidget.tsx` (`SINGLE_SERIES` family comment, objectui#11417) covers dropped MEASURES on these families, not a pivoted second dimension.
- PR #27560 (#27460) gives sankey a two-level draw for the same input; it is the nearest precedent for a fix shape, not a ruling for these families (a pie may need a refusal or a note instead of a second ring).

Noted, not filed: `buildChartSeries` pivots only `dimensions[1]`; a third dimension collapses into the (d0, d1) cell (last row wins) on every family.
